transcript.text: Claude Code built this whole app while I made lunch.
The trick is one file most people never write.
Before you ask for anything, write a short plan file: what it is, what done looks like, what not to touch.
Then tell it to read the plan first, every time.
That is it. Fewer mistakes, fewer rewrites.
Save this so you do it on your next project.
